 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Phallocentrisim'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Phallocentrism'.**
 
• The word '**Phallocentrism**' refers to a concept in feminist theory, emphasizing the central role of masculinity or male perspective in culture and society.
 
• **For Example -** The critique of phallocentrism challenges traditional patriarchal ideologies.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Phallocentrisim'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Meanings of the other terms:**

 
• **Hermeneutics -** The study of interpretation, especially of texts and symbolic expressions.
 
• **Structuralism -** An intellectual movement analyzing cultural phenomena as systems of relationships and structures.
 
• **Metafiction -** Fiction that self-consciously examines its own narrative and literary conventions.
